subject: K-8 Recess and Wellness Policy Revisions
overview: The subcommittee met to discuss formalizing recess standards for K-8 students within the district's wellness policy. The discussion focused on defining child-directed play, standardizing weather-related indoor recess triggers, and restricting the use of recess withholding as a disciplinary measure.

items.title: Wellness Policy ADF Revision
items.summary: The subcommittee reviewed a proposal to revise Policy ADF to ensure daily unrestricted free play for K-8 students and require biannual data reporting on any instances where recess is curtailed.

items.title: Current Recess Structure and Definitions
items.summary: Administrators and community members discussed existing recess schedules and proposed a formal definition of child-directed play to ensure time remains personally directed and intrinsically motivated.

items.title: Indoor Recess and Weather Consistency
items.summary: Participants debated the need for consistent, district-wide 'real feel' temperature triggers for indoor recess and discussed alternatives to screen time during inclement weather, such as library access.

items.title: Disciplinary Use of Recess
items.summary: Members discussed prohibiting the withholding of recess for discipline or academic makeup, though some administrators advocated for maintaining 'logical consequences' when students exhibit unsafe behavior during play.

items.title: Future Policy Language and Data Tracking
items.summary: The chair identified key components for drafting at the next meeting, including consistent weather guidelines, a formal definition of recess, and methods for tracking recess curtailment by demographic data.
